text_block_list.text:
One day, a fan letter arrived for Seeking 
the Pearl—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, to take the time and pen your 
feelings to me... I must properly receive 
such burning passion!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Excellent! She said that after being 
inspired by me, she decided to take on the 
challenge of running a café!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing Pearl-san keep taking on 
challenges made me want to accomplish 
something myself."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"It was tough when we first opened, but 
we're finally on track. Please come by and 
have a meal if you'd like, Pearl-san"... 
How wonderful!
choice_data_list: Pearl's hard work gave everyone courage.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that's right... I'm so glad.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's go check out this 
person's shop!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the invite, I came here to 
eat!!

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper Fan
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Whaaaaat!? P-Pearl-sa... W-Welcome 
to the store!?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
What would you recommend most at this 
shop?

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper Fan
text_block_list.text:
"Y-Yes! Um, our shop is very particular 
about our homemade fruit... so I highly 
recommend the cake generously topped with 
it!"

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper Fan
text_block_list.text:
We have a field right behind the shop, so 
we make them with freshly picked fruit 
every morning!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: How lovely! I'll take that one!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~~~ Delicious!! It has the most 
wonderfully juicy flavor! This must be 
super popular, right!?

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper Fan
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Y-Yes, that's true... Some people 
get hooked once they try it, but... to be 
honest, it's not really that popular.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... that's far too much of a waste!! 
Why not market it on a much grander scale 
to create some real buzz around it?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
For instance, let's see... How about 
letting the customers pick their favorite 
fruit to top their cake and harvest it 
themselves?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I call it the Homemade Fruit Hunting 
Cake!!

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper Fan
text_block_list.text:
I-It's so innovative!! That would 
definitely get people talking... I'll give 
it a try!

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper Fan
text_block_list.text:
Pearl-san really is amazing! She always 
comes up with eccentric ideas and takes on 
interesting challenges... Once again, I 
truly respect her!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm glad I could help. And thanks to 
you too, as always, for your support!

A few days later—Seeking the Pearl 
received another fan letter. It seemed to 
be from the owner of the cafe from the 
other day, but...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's fantastic! I hear your hunting 
cake with homemade fruit has been super 
popular since then!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Further pursuing the potential of 
homegrown fruit, she is now planning to 
create her own original beauty serum." 
...it says. Heh, what a great endeavor.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"I can't fall behind either! I'll deliver 
even more fabulous results and spread the 
circle of challenge across the world!!"

From that day on, Seeking the Pearl became 
even more passionate about her training.
